title: Iceland’s Ring Road
description: The Open Road Collection · 003. Signature Extended Edition: six scenic stops on Iceland's Ring Road, real photographs, Nordic soundscape and closed-loop cartography. One main photo per destination.
author: OpenMotion Studio
